svg.title: A nurse is providing teaching to the parents of a 4-year-old child about fine motor development. Which of the following tasks should the nurse include in the teaching as an expected finding for this age group?
svg.desc: Copying a circle is the only one a 4-year-old can do. It is a 3-year skill, and that is the trap — the question asks for an expected finding , not the newest skill, and children do not lose skills. The shape ladder is circle at 3, square at 4, triangle at 5 , diamond around 6–7. Everything else here comes later: printing first and last name is about 5 , cutting food with a table knife is about 6–7 (spreading with a knife comes first, at 5), and cursive is about 8 . Work by elimination — rule out anything that comes after the age in the stem, and what is left is the answer.
